corrections.what: Gave the two checkboxes one size, 23.0 px square outside, on one column (centre x 81.12), each keeping its measured centre height
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats. The upper (checked) box measures 23.3 by 24.25 px outside with a 12.7 by 14.1 px window; the lower box 22.25 by 21.9 with a 12 by 11.5 window. The upper box's edges move in by up to 0.6 px and the lower box's out by up to 0.55 px.

corrections.what: Drew the check as one W stroke from inside the left border, down to a vertex at (81, 35.6) and up into the top-right corner of the window
corrections.why: Matches the sheet's check, whose left arm merges with the box's left side and whose right arm merges with the window's top-right corner, leaving the two light pockets the sheet shows. The left arm runs 4.4 px thick on the sheet; at W its lower edge sits about 0.8 px lower.

corrections.what: Left out the faint diagonal mark inside the lower checkbox
corrections.why: DR-03 raster accident. It is a 1.5 px grey ghost (green 128 to 165 against ink near 10 and ground near 220), below the ink threshold in both sheets and far lighter than any drawn stroke. Drawing it at W would read as a slash or a second check and change the empty box's meaning.

corrections.what: Mirrored the resident row about x 101.8, with equal heads and bodies for each pair (tall heads r 11.3, bodies rx 21.33 and ry 18.75; small heads r 8.18)
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry and equal repeats. Tall figures measure axes 32.05 and 171.85, arch rx 21.52 and 21.14, ry 18.89 and 18.61; small figures 77.95 and 125.27 with head radii 8.17 and 8.19. No part moves more than 0.2 px.

corrections.what: Drew each small resident's shoulders as one symmetric quadratic curve from foot to foot
corrections.why: The shoulders have no straight sides: their drop from the top grows with the square of the distance from the axis (an ellipse fit collapses to a parabola), so a quadratic matches to within about 0.5 px.

corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats. Rule ends differ by up to 0.4 px. Their vertical positions stay as drawn, since the sheet groups two rules with the upper box and one plus a short stub with the lower box.

notes: Kept: two checkboxes, four rules, four residents, the page drawn as an open frame whose left side stops at y 78 and right side at y 48, so the residents stand in front with no page bottom drawn. Sheet disagreement: the red sheet tints the lower checkbox's top bar dark maroon and its window faintly pink, while the black sheet and the rest of the red sheet treat that box as a plain black empty box. The clearly intended reading is one selected red box and one empty black box, so the lower box stays black. That tint accounts for 61 of the 501 reference red pixels, which is most of the gap in red IoU.
